headline: Thursday: WNBA Finals Game 6 at 9:30 AM PT (Valkyries @ Dream, Golden State leads 3-2), Panthers @ Packers on Thursday Night Football, NBA, and NHL. The Brewers won the World Series last night.

record.label: Yesterday (Wed 10/28)
record.note: Big night. The Brewers won Game 5 4-1 for their first-ever title. Everything else hit too: 76ers -4.5 (won by 5), Bulls +7.5 (lost by 6), Hornets-Pistons Under (186), the Mavericks outright (120-96), the Avalanche (5-2) and Leafs-Kraken Over (5-4). Only Misiorowski Over 3.5 hits lost (he allowed 2). The Haliburton prop couldn't be confirmed. The board is down about 1.3 units overall.

notes: WNBA Finals Game 6 tips at 9:30 AM PT — very soon. Bet it now or skip it.
No bet is a lock. 'Confidence' runs 1–5, and nothing on this board is above a 3.
Odds move. Skip any pick whose price is past the 'playable to' number in its reasoning.

sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: The strongest edges across today's card. Wednesday these went 2-0. Today three sources land on Carolina with the points, and two agree on the Cavaliers.

straight.reasoning: Covers, TheSpread and RG.org all take Carolina. The Panthers are 13-0 against the spread after an outright loss, and they won outright at Lambeau last season as 13.5-point underdogs. Green Bay is 1-9-1 against the spread after a loss and has the league's worst run game. The line has drifted from -4 to -3.5 despite more tickets on Green Bay. Risk: Carolina is missing both starting tackles and Jaelan Phillips. Playable at +3.5; skip at +3.

RG.org and Dimers' model (55%) both pick Cleveland. The Cavs have won three straight, while Atlanta has lost three straight and is winless at home. Risk: Cleveland is on the second night of a back-to-back. Playable to -115.

TheSpread and Covers both lean Under. Green Bay's last four games averaged 35.5 combined points, the Packers are 5-2 to the Under, Carolina is 3-0 to the Under on the road, and both offensive lines are banged up. The total has already dropped. TheLines expects more scoring from Jordan Love, so it's half a unit. Playable to 46.5.

parlay.title: Dog and Under (SGP)
parlay.reasoning: A low-scoring game helps the underdog stay within a field goal. TheSpread calls these two picks linked. The book will pay less than shown.

sections.label: Baseball
sections.slate: Season over: the Brewers beat the Rays 4-1 in Game 5 to win their first World Series. Misiorowski threw 5.2 scoreless innings. Thanks for riding along this October.

sections.label: Football
sections.slate: Thursday Night Football: Panthers @ Packers, 5:15 PM PT on Prime Video. Packers -3.5, total 47-47.5. Carolina is missing both starting tackles and Jaelan Phillips; Green Bay is without its starting center and Micah Parsons. College: Florida Atlantic @ North Texas (4:30 PM PT).

straight.reasoning: Three sources agree, Carolina has a strong bounce-back trend, and Green Bay has a poor record covering after losses. Skip at +3.
Green Bay's last four games averaged 35.5 points, and both offensive lines are hurt. Playable to 46.5.
North Texas is unbeaten at home and averages 43.1 points a game. RG.org's pick. A late backdoor touchdown is the risk, so it's a quarter unit.

sections.label: Hockey
sections.slate: Thursday card includes Canadiens @ Stars and Capitals @ Predators (5:00 PM PT).

straight.reasoning: Dallas allows the fewest goals in the NHL, both goalies have strong save percentages, and Montreal's power play ranks 29th. Plus money. RG.org's pick. An empty-netter is the risk.

sections.label: Basketball
sections.slate: WNBA Finals Game 6: Valkyries @ Dream, 9:30 AM PT, with Golden State one win from the title. Dream -4.5, total 147.5. Sources split on the total (Yahoo and SportsBettingDime lean low, Dimers' model likes the Over), so only a small play. NBA tonight: Cavaliers @ Hawks and Kings @ Pelicans (5:00 PM PT), and more.

straight.reasoning: Two sources agree. Cleveland has won three straight, and Atlanta is winless at home. Playable to -115.
Dimers' model gives the Kings a 52.7% chance to cover. Quarter unit.

The series has averaged 138.5 points (much lower without the 168-point Game 3), Golden State is 8-1-1 to the Under in its last 10, and an early tip could mean tired legs. Yahoo's pick, and SportsBettingDime likes a low Valkyries team total. Dimers' model disagrees, so it's a quarter unit.
